data.gender_notes: Naziah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nazahah' meaning 'to flow' or 'to grace'. This name is often used to describe someone who moves with grace and elegance, or who is bestowed with divine blessings. The name Naziah carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naziah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
